prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 合规审查法律条文引用表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 3 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "法律名称" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 261px
  col 2: header "条款" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 3: header "条文内容" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 4732px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"将合规审查涉及的法律名称、具体条款和条文内容对应起来，供读者查找法律依据。","reading":"读者先按法律名称定位，再通过条款核对具体出处，最后阅读同一行的条文内容；长条文会形成较高的行，为法律名称换行提供空间。","groups":["法律名称与条款共同构成引用出处，应便于连续扫描和对应。","条文内容是被引用的正文，与同一行的出处配合阅读，但需要更多宽度容纳长文本。"],"keep_intact":["条款编号应尽可能保持完整，避免数字与“第”“条”分离。","法律名称中的书名号和名称应尽可能保持清晰、易于辨认。","条文中的法律术语和标点关系应保持可读。"],"may_wrap":["法律名称可在汉字之间自然换行，较高的正文行通常能吸收这些换行。","条文正文可自然换行，但过窄会增加阅读负担。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [90, 90, 179] · table 360×3115px · row heights [36, 757, 385, 385, 618, 478, 455] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 32 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [120, 145, 94] · table 360×7625px · row heights [36, 1896, 920, 966, 1524, 1176, 1106] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 81 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [145, 65, 149] · table 360×3835px · row heights [36, 920, 478, 478, 780, 594, 548] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 39 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"三列表头完整，出处与正文的对应关系清楚；正文获得三者中最多的宽度，阅读节奏和表格总高度都优于另外两案。","problems":"法律名称常被切成较短的多行；较长条款编号也跨行，影响按出处快速核对。正文仍然较窄，长条文需要连续阅读很多行。","cause":"法律名称列和条款列各为90px，扣除边距后文字宽度仅69px；正文列179px，文字宽度为158px。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"法律名称和条款编号有较充足的空间，出处容易辨认，表头也完整。","problems":"正文成为很窄的文字带，行数和表格高度急剧增加；出处单元格留下大量空白，整行的比例失衡，跨行对应也更费力。","cause":"前两列占用265px，正文列仅94px，扣除边距后只有73px可排文字。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"法律名称列较宽，名称通常只需少量换行；正文仍保留连续阅读的空间，表头完整。","problems":"条款编号被切成很多短行，出处扫描受阻；法律名称列在高行中留下大量空白，而正文比r0A更窄、更长。","cause":"法律名称列145px占用了较多宽度，条款列65px扣除边距后仅44px；正文列149px也比r0A少30px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"正文优先","widths":[80,90,189],"change":"以r0A为基础，将法律名称列缩窄10px并全部让给正文；名称可以利用正文带来的行高自然换行，同时改善长条文的阅读宽度。"},{"name":"出处均衡","widths":[80,110,169],"change":"缩窄法律名称列，为条款增加20px，使较长编号的换行更少；正文仍保留全表最大宽度，检验出处扫描与正文阅读的折中。"},{"name":"编号完整","widths":[75,144,140],"change":"尝试让条款列提供123px文字空间，以容纳最长编号；法律名称采用较窄的多行排法，观察编号完整带来的好处是否值得正文变窄。"}]}
